head_subject: Validate primary angular tables and reference-multipole boundaries
old_Qfit_bullet: - The CLOVER asymmetry is related to physical polarization by `A=QP`; calibration reactions give `Q=0.30(3)` at 256 keV down to `0.15(1)` at 1230 keV, and the fitted response is `Q=Q0(0.31(2)+7(2)×10^-4 Eγ)` (PDF pp.18–19, Table 1, Eq.5).
